description: Authoritative mission events for Apollo 11 extracted from NASA MSC-00171 (Apollo 11 Mission Report), Table 3-I (Sequence of Events), Table 7-II, Table 7-VII, and Table 5-IV. Covers all events identified in Astraeus Spike 02 Brief Section 12 from launch through splashdown.

events.label: Lift-off
events.notes: Range zero was 13:32:00 G.m.t., July 16, 1969; lift-off occurred at 13:32:00.6 GMT.

events.label: S-IVB engine cutoff (Earth orbit insertion)
events.notes: S-IVB cutoff; Section 7.2 cites Earth parking orbit insertion at 00:11:49.3.

events.label: Translunar injection maneuver ignition
events.notes: S-IVB reignition for translunar injection.

events.label: Translunar injection maneuver cutoff
events.notes: S-IVB cutoff after translunar injection; Table 7-II also lists TLI condition state at 02:50:13.2.

events.label: Command and service module / S-IVB separation
events.notes: CSM separates from S-IVB stage prior to transposition and docking.

events.label: First docking (CSM with LM)
events.notes: Command module docks with lunar module while LM is still secured in S-IVB SLA.

events.label: Spacecraft ejection (from S-IVB)
events.notes: Docked CSM/LM stack extracted and ejected from S-IVB stage.

events.label: Separation maneuver ignition (from S-IVB)
events.notes: SPS RCS separation burn to distance spacecraft from S-IVB; cutoff at 04:40:04.7.

events.label: First midcourse correction (MCC-1) ignition
events.notes: Translunar midcourse correction burn; cutoff at 26:45:01.8 (firing duration 3.1 sec, delta-V 20.9 ft/sec).

events.label: Lunar orbit insertion (LOI-1) ignition
events.notes: SPS engine ignition for lunar orbit insertion into 169.7 x 60.0 n mi orbit; cutoff at 75:55:48.0 (firing time 357.5 sec, delta-V 2917.5 ft/sec).

events.label: Lunar orbit circularization (LOI-2) ignition
events.notes: SPS burn circularizing orbit to 65.7 x 53.8 n mi; cutoff at 80:11:53.6 (firing time 16.8 sec, delta-V 158.8 ft/sec).

events.label: Undocking
events.notes: Lunar Module Eagle undocks from Command/Service Module Columbia during lunar revolution 13.

events.label: Separation maneuver ignition (CSM from LM)
events.notes: CSM RCS separation maneuver from LM; cutoff at 100:40:01.9 (delta-V 1.4 ft/sec).

events.label: Descent orbit insertion (DOI) ignition
events.notes: LM descent propulsion system burn lowering pericynthion to ~8 n mi; cutoff at 101:36:44.0 (firing time 30.0 sec, delta-V 76.4 ft/sec).

events.label: Powered descent initiation (PDI)
events.notes: LM descent engine ignition for final powered descent to lunar surface (printed as 102:33:05.2 in Table 3-I and 102:33:05.1 in Table 7-II).

events.label: Lunar landing (touchdown)
events.notes: Touchdown at Tranquility Base (Landing Site 2 coordinates 0.67408N, 23.47297E).

events.label: Lunar lift-off
events.notes: LM ascent stage engine ignition from lunar surface.

events.label: Lunar orbit insertion engine cutoff (Ascent)
events.notes: LM ascent engine cutoff into 48.0 x 9.4 n mi orbit (firing time 434.9 sec, delta-V 6070.1 ft/sec).

events.label: Coelliptic sequence initiation (CSI) ignition
events.notes: RCS maneuver to circularize orbit relative to CSM orbit; cutoff at 125:20:22.5 (firing time 47.0 sec, delta-V 51.5 ft/sec).

events.label: Constant differential height (CDH) maneuver ignition
events.notes: RCS burn equalizing orbital differential height to 15 n mi below CSM (firing time 17.8 sec, delta-V 19.9 ft/sec).

events.label: Terminal phase initiation (TPI) ignition
events.notes: RCS maneuver targeting line of sight to CSM; cutoff at 127:04:14.5 (firing time 22.7 sec, delta-V 25.3 ft/sec).

events.label: Terminal phase finalize (TPFI)
events.notes: Braking and velocity matching with CSM in 63.0 x 56.5 n mi orbit (firing time 28.4 sec, delta-V 31.4 ft/sec).

events.label: Docking (CSM and LM ascent stage)
events.notes: Eagle ascent stage docks with Columbia.

events.label: Ascent stage jettison
events.notes: Eagle ascent stage jettisoned after crew and lunar sample transfer.

events.label: Separation maneuver ignition (from ascent stage)
events.notes: CSM RCS separation burn from jettisoned ascent stage; cutoff at 130:30:08.2 (firing time 7.2 sec, delta-V 2.2 ft/sec).

events.label: Transearth injection maneuver ignition
events.notes: SPS engine burn behind the Moon injecting Columbia into return trajectory toward Earth; cutoff at 135:26:13.7 (firing time 151.4 sec, delta-V 3279.0 ft/sec).

events.label: Command module / service module separation
events.notes: Columbia Command Module separates from Service Module prior to atmospheric entry.

events.label: Entry interface (400 000 feet altitude)
events.notes: Atmospheric entry interface at geodetic altitude 400 000 ft (65.8 n mi), inertial velocity 36 194.4 ft/sec, flight-path angle -6.48 deg.

events.label: Drogue deployment
events.notes: Drogue parachutes deployed at ~10 000 ft altitude.

events.label: Splashdown / Landing
events.notes: Splashdown in the Pacific Ocean at 13.30N, 169.15W (USS Hornet recovery).

omitted_events.label: Translunar MCC-2, MCC-3, MCC-4
omitted_events.reason: Omitted from trajectory events because they were cancelled/not executed during flight; translunar injection and MCC-1 accuracy were sufficient to meet nominal lunar orbit insertion criteria without additional burns (MSC-00171 Section 7.4.3, page 7-3).

omitted_events.label: Transearth MCC-1, MCC-3, MCC-4
omitted_events.reason: Omitted from trajectory events because they were cancelled/not executed during flight; the single midcourse correction executed at GET 150:29:57.4 satisfied all entry interface targeting requirements (MSC-00171 Section 7.4.9, page 7-5).

omitted_events.label: Lunar surface EVA egress and ingress
omitted_events.reason: Lunar surface EVA egress (GET 109:07:33) and ingress (GET 111:39:13) are documented timeline events (Table 3-I) but omitted from spacecraft trajectory modeling because the Lunar Module remained stationary on the lunar surface throughout the surface stay.
